## Our investment Theme

Here’s who we’re seeking!

##### Deep Tech

If you are a company building Deep Tech solutions that push the frontiers of innovation—whether in advanced computing, AI/ML, cybersecurity, or novel infrastructure technologies across a wide range of needs —reach out to us!

##### FinTech

If you are a fintech company harnessing AI and machine learning technologies to innovate in areas like predictive analytics, fraud detection, credit scoring, robo-advisory, algorithmic trading, etc., reach out to us!

##### Cybersecurity

If you are developing cutting-edge solutions to protect businesses and organisations from cyber threats, safeguard sensitive data and ensure compliance with regulator requirements,  reach out to us!

##### **AI-First**

If you are an AI-first company building products and services with artificial intelligence as its core foundation rather than a bolt-on feature—reshaping industries through automation, decision intelligence, and adaptive scalability, reach out to us!

## Our investment Strategy

At Pinwheel, we are committed to partnering with visionary entrepreneurs and companies that exhibit the potential for transformative growth. Our investment philosophy is built on several core principles:

##### Visionary   Founders

We back entrepreneurs who distinguish themselves as innovators and business leaders. We look for deep industry knowledge, strong problem-solving abilities and the drive to scale their ventures to 10-20X or more in revenue. These founders possess the passion and resilience to turn big ideas into impactful businesses.

##### Collaborative  Partnerships

Our approach goes beyond financial backing. We seek founders who are eager to learn, open to collaboration and unafraid to ask for guidance. We believe the most successful companies are built on strong partnerships, mutual trust and a shared commitment to navigating challenges together.

##### Early-Stage  Commitment

We focus on early-stage investments, believing this is where our involvement can create the most value. We partner with post-revenue companies, generally with revenue run rates between $500,000 and $2,000,000 and we prefer to enter at the first institutional funding round to provide early strategic guidance.

##### B2B Software   Led Services

Our investments are centered around B2B Software led services companies, with an emphasis on sectors shaping the future of work, cybersecurity, fintech AI and enterprise AI. We typically invest in Seed or Series A rounds, working with businesses that have a clear path to transforming their industries.

##### Scalable and Defensible Models

We are drawn to businesses with recurring revenue models that combine product and service elements. We favor companies with a unique market position, where their competitive edge extends beyond short-term technological gains, ensuring they can grow and sustain a long-term market presence.

##### Capital   Sustainability

We align with founders who are disciplined in their approach to raising and utilizing capital. These entrepreneurs carefully consider the timing and amounts of capital raised, balancing growth objectives with capital efficiency to maximize their potential for success.
